A.question: Does quantization naturally change tool-use behavior without attack training?
A.claim_boundary: baseline only; cannot establish constructible attack

B.question: Can attack construction hide a target tool action in BF16 and reveal it after quantization?
B.claim_boundary: requires independent training seeds and locked controls

C.question: When does structured output produce a real synthetic-Agent state transition, and which defenses stop it?
defenses: schema plus canonical normalization plus allowlist
C.executor: deterministic synthetic executor; no filesystem, network, shell, email, payment, account, or credential access

gates.technical_validity: may block analysis or artifact acceptance
gates.behavioral_evaluation: must classify CONFIRMATORY, EXPLORATORY, or ATTACK_FAILED but must not suppress an otherwise technically valid planned quantization arm

statistical_unit.do_sample_false_note: inference seeds are repeatability checks, not independent samples

data_hygiene: training, repair, utility, development, and final evaluation splits must have verified prompt/entity/template separation
unverified historical datasets cannot enter a formal matrix
backend_sequence: pilot: one model, one training seed, one native backend
main: eligible model, three independent training seeds, INT8 plus one 4-bit backend
cross-model: second family single seed before three-seed expansion
